tasks.short: Write the regulatory strategy for a new product.

steps.what: List submission milestones for the new product.
Develop regulatory strategies and the implementation plan.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} file shows the required sections and dates for this product before a strategy is written. The regulatory affairs manager develops the implementation plan and signs that version. A missing section stops the plan. The screen does not decide that the product may be submitted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Milestones lived in mail and in personal notes, so a new product started from memory of the last filing.
tasks.enabler_now: The required headings and dates can be listed from the file the company already keeps.
tasks.still_hard: A new rule, a new market, and a scientific gap the milestone list does not name.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can see that a complete checklist still leaves the product unready.

ambition.what: Each new product gets a signed implementation plan in the week the file opens, including a plan that says the file is not ready.

tasks.altitude: The plan is dated and signed. The strategy itself is still the manager's writing. Nothing is sent to an agency from this task.

reach.task: Map a control to a written obligation and record the gap.
reach.learn: The headings can be listed. The strategy is still written here.

evidence.claim: A register can list submission headings and dates for a product type. It cannot choose the regulatory strategy.

EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with a legal effect. The agency receives a package only after the manager signs that exact version. The job digest treats rule registers as document work, not as product authorisation.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A regulatory affairs manager at a European product company. National product rules apply. A checklist does not authorise a product.

Fields: Product id, market, and required heading, produced by the submission file. A heading with no id is not on the list. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the submission checklist already stored for that product type before a new register.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
unknowns: Which markets this product will enter.
Who else may sign a strategy besides the manager.
research_questions: Is the heading list current for this product type?
Which dates are legal deadlines rather than internal targets?

already_counted.description: The manager still writes the strategy.

incremental.description: The manager adds a heading when a market is added.

approvals.approved_version: plan version and the milestone list shown to the manager

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the milestone list and the storing of a signed plan. It disappears when the product type has no heading list and the manager rebuilds the plan by hand.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review agency submission materials for compliance.

steps.what: Assemble submission materials and their due dates.
Mark late or missing sections in the submission materials.

loop.input: the section pack and the required headings
loop.check: each gap names a heading or a date that is in the file
loop.stop: stop when a gap names neither
loop.why_not_simpler: the pack is prose and tables, and a fixed form cannot see a missing narrative section

steps.what: Review accuracy, comprehensiveness, and regulatory compliance.
File the signed review of the submission materials.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} pack lists each section and its date before the review. A gap is kept only when it names a heading or a date already in the file. The regulatory affairs manager reviews accuracy and regulatory compliance, then signs that review. Timeliness flags do not pass the science.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reviewers hunted missing sections by memory while also judging the science, so a late appendix was found at the end.
tasks.enabler_now: Headings and dates can be compared before the manager reads the content.
tasks.still_hard: A section that is present and wrong, and a standard that is not in the checklist.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can tell a complete section from a section that only has the right heading.

ambition.what: A late or missing section is shown on the day the date is in the file, and the manager still judges the content.

tasks.altitude: The gap list is ready before the reading. The compliance judgement stays with the manager. The review is filed only after that signature.

reach.task: Check a packet against a control list and record the exception.
reach.learn: The list can be mechanical. The exception judgement is the same kind of work.

evidence.claim: A checklist can mark a missing heading or a passed date. It cannot judge whether the science in a section is right.

EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with a legal effect. The agency receives a package only after the manager signs that exact version. The job digest treats rule registers as document work, not as product authorisation. A drafted sentence may cite only a rule or a figure already in the file. A sentence with neither stops and the manager rewrites it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A regulatory affairs manager at a European product company. National product rules apply. A checklist does not authorise a product.

Fields: Section id, required heading, and due date, produced by the submission file. A section with no heading id is not auto-marked complete. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the heading list already stored for the agency and the product type.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
A drafted sentence may cite only a rule or a figure already in the file. A sentence with neither stops and the manager rewrites it.
unknowns: Which agency standard this dossier is written against.
Whether a sister company must review the same pack.
research_questions: Which headings are mandatory for this submission type?
How often is a present section still rejected?

already_counted.description: The manager still reviews the content.

incremental.description: The manager adds a heading when the agency changes the form.

approvals.approved_version: review note id and the gap list shown to the manager

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is assembly and the gap marks. It shrinks when the heading list is for the wrong agency and the manager rechecks every section by hand.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct preparation and submission of agency filings.

steps.what: Collect regulatory agency applications, reports, and correspondence.
Direct the preparation until the pack is complete.
Submit the signed pack on the agency portal.

tasks.design: Approved sections are collected in {DOCS} and the manager directs what is still missing. Only that signed version is submitted through the {GOV_PORTAL}. A section the manager has not accepted stays out of the pack. The portal call is refused when the signature does not match the pack.
tasks.previous_blocker: Correspondence and reports were assembled by hand just before a deadline, and the portal upload was a separate copy.
tasks.enabler_now: Sections already accepted can be collected, and a portal can take a file the manager has signed.
tasks.still_hard: An agency that still wants a wet-ink original, and a report that is not finished.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows which missing page is fatal and which can be a follow-up letter.
tasks.altitude: Preparation is directed by the manager. The only machine action is sending a pack that person has already signed. The right to submit does not move.

reach.task: File a notice only after the owner has signed the exact text.
reach.learn: The send can be a portal call. The decision to send stays here.

evidence.claim: A portal can accept a file upload. It cannot decide that an application is ready to send.

EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with a legal effect. The agency receives a package only after the manager signs that exact version. The job digest treats rule registers as document work, not as product authorisation.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A regulatory affairs manager at a European product company. National product rules apply. A checklist does not authorise a product.

Fields: Application id, accepted section id, and signature id, produced by the submission file. A section without an acceptance mark is left out. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the agency portal the company already files through before building a second channel.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
unknowns: Which filings this company sends through a portal and which go by post.
research_questions: Does this agency accept the signed file without a further cover letter?
What is refused if the receipt does not return?

already_counted.description: The manager still directs the preparation.

incremental.description: The manager reconciles a portal receipt that does not match the pack.

approvals.approved_version: pack id and the section list the manager directed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is collecting accepted sections and the portal send of a signed pack. It disappears when the agency rejects the channel and the manager submits by hand.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate a product complaint and prepare the file.

steps.what: Log the product complaint fields and the lot.
Investigate the product complaint and record the finding.
Draft the agency submission from that finding only.

loop.check: every sentence cites a sentence in the finding
loop.stop: stop when a sentence has no citation
loop.why_not_simpler: the finding is prose, and a fixed letter would add a cause

steps.what: Sign the complaint submission before it can be sent.

tasks.design: The complaint is logged in {WORKFLOW} with the lot and the date. The regulatory affairs manager investigates and writes the finding. A draft in {DOCS} may use only that finding. No cause is filled in by the screen. The draft is not sent from this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Complaint notes sat in mail, and the agency letter was written while the cause was still a guess.
tasks.enabler_now: The lot, the date, and the finding can sit in one record before anyone drafts.
tasks.still_hard: A sample that is gone, a patient outcome, and a cause that the file does not support.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can refuse a tidy cause that the sample does not support.
tasks.altitude: The investigation stays with the manager. The draft cannot add a cause. Sending to the agency is a later signed act, not this screen.

reach.task: Keep a complaint record and a person's finding before any external letter.
reach.learn: The record can be structured. The finding cannot be generated.

evidence.claim: A complaint register can store a lot, a date, and a finding. It cannot decide the cause.

Speaking for the company, training people, and finding a cause stay with the manager. EU GDPR article 22 is not met by a screen that closes a complaint or picks a sentence. A drafted sentence may cite only a rule or a figure already in the file. A sentence with neither stops and the manager rewrites it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A regulatory affairs manager at a European product company. National product rules apply. A checklist does not authorise a product.

Fields: Complaint id, product lot, and finding text, produced by the complaint record. A complaint with no lot is not drafted. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the complaint register the quality team already keeps.
The draft is not an external send. A later send needs a new signature on the exact text.
unknowns: Whether this product's complaints go to a medicines agency or a device authority.
Who may see a patient identifier.
research_questions: Which complaint fields are mandatory before an investigation starts?
How often is the first stated cause later changed?

already_counted.description: The manager still signs the draft.

incremental.description: The manager corrects a draft sentence that failed the citation check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the log and a draft that may only quote the finding. It disappears when the lot is unknown and the manager writes the whole file by hand.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager still writes the regulatory strategy and still investigates the complaint. A submission can be assembled and checked for missing sections before that work.
reach: Compliance managers keep an obligation register, and this job learns a heading list is not the scientific review.
Medical and health services managers run a complaint file, and this job learns the cause is still a person's finding.
skills_to_grow: Read a submission section back to a required heading before it is called complete.
Keep a complaint finding in the file before any sentence is written to an agency.
role.ambitious_version: A new product gets a dated submission plan in the same week the file opens, and the agency still receives only what the manager has signed.
